label: late original-phase / <DEL> steps in sequences starting with k
explanation: Fires only in the last few original-token steps (t=5..9, mostly t>=6) and at the <DEL> step of long sequences (L>=7, rate rising with L). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<5. Its main driver is the first original token: about 79% of activation mass comes from sequences that start with k (lift 20x). Sequences starting with j or t make up a small secondary share. Within those sequences, activations are larger on later steps and when w appears among the early tokens: the top examples are mostly k ? w ... sequences, and adding seen(w) raises precision to 0.58 but cuts recall sharply. Precision is only ~0.36, because many k-initial long sequences never activate it, and the rule deciding which ones do was not captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=k (+9.08), orig0=j (+4.25), orig0=t (+4.17), orig1=k (+4.12), orig0=p (+3.39), orig2=w (+3.16). Lower it: phase=2 (-10.31), prev3_tok=- (-5.95), t=3 (-5.51), t=4 (-4.99).
